description: Na₂TeO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.53 Å. Te is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing TeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and two equivalent Te atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Te₂ trigonal pyramids.
